name: Caveman
summary: The caveman voice for agent replies: answer first, kill greeting, hedging, filler, recap and closers, drop articles when the sentence still reads in one pass; code, commands, paths, numbers and exact error strings stay verbatim. Clarity beats compression: negations, step order and anything persisted outside chat never compress; warnings, irreversible actions, questions and confused users get plain prose. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "less tokens"; not for onboarding or replies other humans will read. Persists until "stop caveman" or "normal mode". /caveman status and the ultra/wenyan aliases follow the optional hub.ultracave/hub.megacave siblings (base voice standalone); hook mode tracking needs the upstream product. Upstream reports honestly: ~3% median output in a single-run snapshot vs an "Answer concisely." control, inside the noise, no quality claim. Verbatim from JuliusBrussee/caveman skills/caveman at the pinned commit (SKILL.md + README only). Apache-2.0.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: caveman 语音：回复先给答案，去掉问候、铺垫、填充、复述与收尾，一遍可读时省略冠词；代码、命令、路径、数字与精确错误串逐字保留。清晰优先于压缩：否定词、步骤顺序、以及任何写入聊天下文的内容绝不压缩；安全警告、不可逆操作确认、向用户提问或用户困惑时自动回到完整散文。适合 /caveman、"caveman mode"、"less tokens"、终端阅读；不适用于 onboarding、面向其他读者的文档。模式持续到 "stop caveman" 或 "normal mode"。/caveman status 探测与 /caveman ultra、/caveman wenyan 别名遵循同源条目 hub.ultracave 与 hub.megacave（可选，基础语音可独立使用）；基于 hook 的模式追踪需要宿主侧 Caveman 产品，本条目不作要求。上游如实报告 token 数字：单次输出长度快照中 caveman 中位数较 "Answer concisely." 对照约省 3%，在噪声范围内，无质量等价声明。自 JuliusBrussee/caveman skills/caveman 钉住 commit 逐字携带（SKILL.md 与 README，不含仓库 CLI/engine 运行时）。许可证 Apache-2.0。

permissionsNote: The upstream SKILL.md declares no allowed-tools; any tool use is the host's decision. The entry carries pure conversational style guidance: no scripts, no network, no credential paths (both carried files read in full at listing time). Hook-based mode tracking and the CLI/engine runtime live in the upstream product and are not part of this entry; only the user can install them.
